name: Remagen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Remagen (a white castle with a crowned wolf on red).
history: The hoisted flag of the city of Remagen is red, white and red striped; the banner is red-white-red 1:2:1 striped lengthwise with the arms laid on; the meaning of the crowned wolf is unexplained.

features.role: Remagen arms — castle with crowned wolf on red
